title: Figure 5: Activated Carbon Porosity (macropores, mesopores, micropores)
description: Simple line diagram of a circular activated carbon particle cut into wedges, showing branching pore channels. Labels identify 'macropores >50nm', 'mesopores 2-50nm' and 'micropores <2nm'. The caption notes pore sizes can range from less than 2 nm to greater than 50 nm.
